headline: Merge it. Pierless takes it from there.
subhead: four things happen, all on their own
title: Merge it. Pierless takes it from there: it deploys instantly, fixes stuck deploys and dropped daemons on its own, reinstalls only what changed, and stays quiet unless something is red. No pier, no port: it drops anchor itself
aside: no pier, no port. it drops anchor itself.
